parent_evidence.interpretation: The K=24 tournament is underdiscriminating because both arms consume most of the common pool and substantially overlap.

question: Under scarce matched budgets on the identical frozen candidate pool, does direct component-cut ranking produce useful contraction earlier than target-subterm coverage ranking?
frozen_candidate_pool: Exactly the pool generator and deterministic rankings from methodology-0036-cut-ranking-tournament-v1; no new candidates, proof rules, fills, anchors, or term budget.

arms.A_TARGET_COVERAGE: prefixes of the existing target-coverage ranking
arms.B_CUT_CONTRACTION: prefixes of the existing cut-distance ranking

primary_statistic: smallest prefix budget K at which each arm strictly contracts the frozen cross-distance 10

decision_table.EARLY_CUT_ADVANTAGE: B has a strictly smaller first-contraction K than A, or at the same K B reaches a strictly smaller cross-distance / joins / closes.
decision_table.RANKINGS_EFFECTIVELY_EQUIVALENT: A and B have the same first-contraction K and identical best cross-distance/join/closure trajectory at every preregistered prefix.
decision_table.PREDICTED_DISTANCE_NONCAUSAL: B contains preregistered predicted contractors but fails to contract by K=12 while A contracts, or no B prefix through K=24 contracts despite the parent pool containing predicted contractors.
decision_table.MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: the parent frozen state (cut 10, 4/19 target-component sizes, 9 reentry edges), common 35-candidate pool, or deterministic rankings cannot be reproduced.

attack_rule: If EARLY_CUT_ADVANTAGE, next run a wrong-direction ranking control and an ablation that preserves the candidate pool but removes cut awareness. Do not expose transfer cases yet.
